name: 印刷报价系统
description: 尺寸、数量、双面、纸价与制版费自动算价，后道工艺费逐项累加

routes.name: 新建报价
routes.summary: 按面积/数量/双面/制版费算价
routes.script:
LET $ins = EXEC INSERT INTO {{t:main}} (job_name, paper, width, height, qty, sides, unit_price, plate_fee, total) VALUES ({{body.job_name}}, {{body.paper}}, {{body.width}}, {{body.height}}, {{body.qty}}, {{body.sides}}, {{body.unit_price}}, {{body.plate_fee}}, ROUND({{body.width}} * {{body.height}} / 10000 * {{body.qty}} * {{body.sides}} * {{body.unit_price}} + {{body.plate_fee}}, 2));
RETURN 201 { "ok": true, "id": $ins.insertId };

docs.summary: 按面积/数量/双面/制版费算价

routes.name: 添加工艺
报价列表
routes.script:
LET $rows = QUERY SELECT id, job_name, paper, qty, total, status FROM {{t:main}} ORDER BY id DESC;
RETURN 200 { "rows": $rows.rows };

routes.name: 报价详情
routes.summary: 报价 + 后道工艺联查

docs.summary: 报价 + 后道工艺联查

routes.name: 确认报价
routes.script:
EXEC UPDATE {{t:main}} SET status = 'quoted' WHERE id = {{id}};
RETURN 200 { "ok": true };

routes.name: 成交
routes.script:
EXEC UPDATE {{t:main}} SET status = 'approved' WHERE id = {{id}} AND status = 'quoted';
RETURN 200 { "ok": true };
